shortDescription: Create, Copy and Update PowerVM Partition Profiles

options.name: action
options.description: C(copy) copies an existing partition profile.

options.name: duplicate_prof_name
options.description: Name of the new profile to be created by copying an existing profile. Required when I(action=copy)

options.name: force
options.description: Forces update of the partition profile when set to C(true). Valid only for I(state=updated). When the Sync Partition with Profile option is enabled, using this option forcefully updates the profile. These changes will take effect the next time the partition profile is activated.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: IPaddress or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: memory_settings
options.description: Memory configuration settings for the partition profile. Valid only for I(state=present) and I(state=updated)

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the existing logical partition profile. Used as the source profile when I(action=copy).

options.name: processor_settings
options.description: Processor configuration settings for the partition profile. Valid only for I(state=present) and I(state=updated).

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the logical partition profile. C(present) creates a new partition profile. C(updated) modify existing partition profile.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system. Required for I(state=present), I(action=copy) and I(state=updated).

options.name: vm_name
options.description: The name of the powervm partition.
